description: Term 6 (Habiro residue) bridged from the f64 producer 'term6_residues_at_roots.py' into the schema expected by mass_formula_6term_mpfr_50dps.term_6_habiro_residue_mp(A). T6 magnitudes for A=1 are small (~2 MeV / m_e ≈ 4 cat units) relative to m_p_hecke (~1.18e6), so the f64 → 50 dps wrap is precision-safe at the current 1.50 % m_p closure gate. Electron T6 (A=0 / H_2) is surfaced as a null row pending an electron-specific residue derivation.
